# pytibero

> Pure Python DB-API 2.0 driver for the Tibero relational database, providing direct connectivity without native client libraries.

pytibero is a lightweight, pure-Python database driver implementing PEP 249 (DB-API 2.0) for Tibero RDBMS. It handles wire-protocol communication, type conversion, connection management, and parameterized queries. Default connection: `tibero://tibero:@localhost:8629/tibero`.

## Core Documentation

- [Installation](https://yeongseon.github.io/pytibero/installation/): pip install, prerequisites, verification
- [Quick Start](https://yeongseon.github.io/pytibero/quickstart/): First connection, basic CRUD, parameterized queries
- [Connection Guide](https://yeongseon.github.io/pytibero/connection/): URL formats, connection parameters, pooling, timeouts
- [API Reference](https://yeongseon.github.io/pytibero/api/): Module, Connection, Cursor classes, DB-API 2.0 globals
- [Type Mapping](https://yeongseon.github.io/pytibero/types/): Tibero-to-Python type conversion, custom type handling

## Reference

- [Error Handling](https://yeongseon.github.io/pytibero/errors/): Exception hierarchy, error codes, troubleshooting
- [Architecture](https://yeongseon.github.io/pytibero/architecture/): Wire protocol, packet format, connection lifecycle
